newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends higher, moving around 891 level.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends higher, moving around 891 level.

text.p: The won closed slightly higher on Monday after it fluctuated in a narrow range at the 891 won level in line with the yen/dollar movement in world markets, dealers said.
They said start-of-the-week importer deals failed to boost the dollar against the won.
The won finished at 891.20, compared with Friday's close of 892.00. Its movement was confined in a 891.80-891.00 range as the dollar drifted sideways against other currencies.
Dealers forecast the dollar would gradually turn bearish, given the dollar selling pressure in forward trading.
"Both banks and corporations are placing selling orders in forward trading," said a dealer.
Dealers forecast the dollar would remain weak on Tuesday.
Monday's trading volume was estimated at $920 million.
Dealers said Tuesday's mid-rate would be pegged at 891.30 against 892.20 today.
